Case reference: 2014004274.CaseDesc: Frédéric Cormier was last seen on January 11, 2001, in the Vieux-Rosemont district of Montreal, Quebec. Frédéric would pick up his son once a week, but he has had no contact since this date.

Case reference: 2014005333.CaseDesc: Jack Nutter attended a medical appointment in Moncton, New Brunswick, in June 2007, later leaving and has not been seen since. Police have not been able to confirm any sightings of Jack since his appointment. Jack's family is concerned for his wellbeing.

Case reference: 2014001059.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1970, the body of a heavyset young adult male with black hair was found on the shore of Kamloops Lake in British Columbia. He had all his teeth removed during his life and had no noticeable scars or tattoos. He is believed to have drowned in the Thompson River near Riverside Park a few days earlier.

Jacket: Nylon, Light Blue, Squall brand with hood, golfer label on front with zipper
Shirt: Blue, Yellow, Corsair brand, checkered pattern
Blue, Longsleeve, Lancer Brand, Size Large, Blue with purple and black check pattern, longsleeve
White, Bluestone brand, long sleeves, size medium
Shoes: Brown, Oxfords, Vibram brand, made in Italy, with shoe laces

Case reference: 2014001191.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2010, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Richelieu River in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2014002848.CaseDesc: Daniel McKenzie was seen for the last time on July 31, 1981, in Schefferville, Quebec. Daniel was reported missing after he was seen leaving a taxi and running into the wilderness along the Quebec and Newfoundland & Labrador border.

Case reference: 2017055687.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2017, Ryan Mead was seen for the last time leaving his family residence in Brampton, Ontario to travel to British Columbia. Ryan purchased camping equipment in Medicine Hat, Alberta in May of 2017. Some of his possessions were recovered along the South Saskatchewan River in late May.

Case reference: 2020011793.CaseDesc: On October 23, 1985, Ruth Koenig was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Ruth had taken some time off from working following the death of her husband on October 18, but never returned.

Case reference: 2018063443.CaseDesc: On July 2, 2003, at approximately 7:00 a.m., Sergio Rodriguez was seen for the last time by his wife in Toronto, Ontario. When Sergio’s wife had returned home from work, he and all of his belongings were gone.

Case reference: 2008023399.CaseDesc: Christine Ziomkiewicz was last seen on June 23, 1978, by colleagues at Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, where she was employed as a laboratory technician. Her vehicle was still in the building's parking lot and there was no indication that she had left the premises intentionally for any period of time. It is not thought that Christine was in a relationship at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2012020114.CaseDesc: Sebastien Metivier went missing in Montreal, Quebec on November 1, 1984. The young boy was in front of the Tres-Saint-Nom-de-Jesus church on the east side of the city and he was heading to an arts and crafts course.

Pants: Blue, Patch on the right knee

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2014004667.CaseDesc: On  November 25, 1999, the Gypsumville RCMP detachment received a report of an aircraft in distress over Lake Winnipeg near Reindeer Island, Manitoba. The aircraft, a single-engine Cherokee 140, was carrying three people; the pilot and two passengers. The pilot had declared that the engine had stalled and that he was trying to reach Reindeer Island. He then stated that he was going into the water. Two RCMP and an Air Search and Rescue Hercules aircrafts conducted an aerial search. It was not possible to search the lake by boat as there was too much ice on the lake. All three are presumed dead from drowning or the impact of the crash.

Case reference: 2019020557.CaseDesc: On April 20, 2019, at 9:00 pm, Rebecca Dorman was last seen leaving a friend's residence located at the intersection of Mohawk Road East and Upper Wellington Street in Hamilton, Ontario. Rebecca had been staying with her friend, and left the residence without her shoes, purse, phone or keys.

Case reference: 2021059908.CaseDesc: On June 16, 2016, the partial remains of an unidentified man were recovered in Renews, Newfoundland and Labrador. Between 2016 and 2018, additional remains belonging to this man were recovered.

Case reference: 2008018099.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1974, at approximately 8:15 hours, Douglas Henderson and Alexander Korecki were canoeing in a 14 foot fiberglass canoe close to the shore in the area of Depot Harbor, Big Sound, in Georgian Bay. The canoe capsized approximately 500 feet away from the campsite.

Case reference: 2014004506.CaseDesc: Michel Satel was last seen on May 8, 2000 in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec. Michel lived in the Laurentians, was known to frequent Montreal, Quebec and often traveled to New Brunswick and Nova Scotia.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Serpent on bicep

Case reference: 2014002360.CaseDesc: On August 25, 1996, Benoit Lachance was seen for the last time in the Pointes-Aux-Trembles District in Montreal, Quebec. Benoit was a member of a motorcycle club called the "Rowdy Crew" and drove a blue Chevrolet Camaro.

Scar: Middle Back, Bullet still in the back

Case reference: 2025054353.CaseDesc: On May 8, 1957, William Gatehouse boarded a bus and departed Winnipeg Manitoba, for a personal trip to Las Vegas Nevada, USA. On May 11, 1957, he telephoned his mother to inform her that he was experiencing difficulties in Salt Lake City, Utah. He requested that his brother contact a local lawyer in Winnipeg and arrange for funds to be sent to him in Salt Lake City.  A second call later that day suggested that he had resolved the issue, no longer required the money, and was continuing on his trip to Las Vegas.  There has been no further communication from William.

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2014005327.CaseDesc: Edward Tandrup was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta in February of 1983. Edward may have been hitchhiking to Vancouver, British Columbia at the time.

Scar: Head, Deep acne scars on face

Case reference: 2019081061.CaseDesc: Robert Nauman was last seen in Toronto, Ontario in 2007.  His family is of the opinion that he may have travelled to Costa Rica.

Case reference: 2021038965.CaseDesc: On May 8, 2012, at approximately 11:25 a.m., Linda Manz was last seen near the area of Prospect Point, on the American side of Niagara Falls. During the time of her disappearance, Linda was despondent.

Case reference: 2014002923.CaseDesc: On March 27, 1998, Jacqueline Olynyk was witnessed walking along the Red River in Winnipeg, Manitoba. We have not received any communication or sightings of Jacqueline since that day.

Case reference: 2014005512.CaseDesc: On October 4, 2010, Ivana Ferus was seen for the last time as she left her residence in Toronto, Ontario, to catch a flight destined for the Czech Republic. Ivana’s apartment keys were subsequently found in a recycling bin.

Case reference: 2006012299.CaseDesc: On June 02, 1984, Andrew Grinnell, his brother, their cousin and a friend departed Sioux Lookout on a canoe trip on the Albany River. The party arrived in Fort Albany on July 18, 1984. At 6:00 p.m. that same day, the party decided to leave Fort Albany in an attempt to paddle to Moosonee via James Bay. The group had planned to go out onto James Bay with the tide and sail to Moosonee by lashing their canoes together. An intense storm engulfed the James Bay coastal area on July 23, 1984, and it is likely that the party perished on the Bay during this storm. Three victims were recovered in August 1984, twelve nautical miles North of the Moose River. Andrew's body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2014002517.CaseDesc: Hélène Laferrière was seen for the last time on November 4, 1976, in the Saint-Sacrement District in Quebec City, Quebec. Hélène has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001761.CaseDesc: Henrietta Mille is originally from Nain, Newfoundland and had been living in St. John’s, Newfoundland for quite some time before her disappearance. Henrietta was known to frequent the clubs in the St. John’s downtown area. Her keys, purse and other belongings were found at the Key Club.

Case reference: 2014004389.CaseDesc: On October 23, 2003, Bertha Melvin, a resident of a group home, left a note saying she was going to hospital. However, she failed to attend.  Bertha is described as very introverted and may have been frequenting urban areas and the Waterways neighbourhood in Fort McMurray, Alberta.

Case reference: 2023030253.CaseDesc: Autumn Shaganash was last seen on June 10, 2023.  She has had no activity on her bank account, no money on her person, and no cellphone. Autumn, according to her immediate family, suffers from depression and anxiety and must take prescribed medication on a daily basis. She hasn't taken her medication since.

Case reference: 2014003015.CaseDesc: Donald Williamson, a man with a history of disappearance, is missing from The Pas, Manitoba. He was reported missing by his brother on September 6, 1984. There is no indication of any foul play in this matter.

Case reference: 2012020105.CaseDesc: Marilyn Bergeron, has been missing since February 17, 2008, from St-Romuald, Québec.

Boots: Suede, Black, with a fur trimmed contour
Coat: Black, Long coat with a fur hood

Case reference: 2014005046.CaseDesc: On June 10, 2007, at approximately 3:45 p.m., Remi Bouchard was seen for the last time on a floatation device in the Bow River near Calgary, Alberta. Remi disappeared into the water after being trapped at the base of the weir.

Case reference: 2023067749.CaseDesc: On November 27, 1989, Thomas Nightengale was last seen in the area of the Upper Niagara River in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. Thomas was despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014001852.CaseDesc: On March 26, 1995, Rhonda Runningbird was last seen near Swan Lake in Clearwater County, Alberta. She walked away from her friends and never returned.

Case reference: 2014001139.CaseDesc: On August 4, 1974, the skeletal remains of a teenage boy were discovered under a log near Lost Lagoon in Stanley Park, Vancouver, British Columbia. He was believed to have died at least a year before his discovery.

Pants: Corduroy, Dark Blue, Button fly pants
Sweater: Synthetic, Dark Blue, Turtleneck, Knitted turtleneck sweater

Case reference: 2014046601.CaseDesc: Jason Beaupit has not been in contact with his family since September 2014. He was last seen on October 19, 2014 at a shelter in downtown Edmonton, Alberta. Jason is known to travel and camp throughout British Columbia and Alberta.

Case reference: 2020013833.CaseDesc: On May 6, 2020, Dylan Ehler was seen for the last time as he wandered off in Truro, Nova Scotia. Following his disappearance, Dylan’s rubber boots were discovered in a nearby brook by divers. This brook flows into a river that flows with the Bay of Fundy.

Jacket: Cloth, Dark Green, Camo with fur around the hood

Case reference: 2012749001.CaseDesc: Lonnie Boudreau was last seen in the city of Ottawa, Ontario in February 1981. He has not been heard from since.

Hair: Blonde, Short, Straight, parted from left to right
Teeth: Good, Small gap between the two front teeth
Mark: Left Side Of Neck, Beauty mark

Case reference: 2021017120.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2021, Nathan Zuk was reported missing by family when he did not return from a boat trip. In mid-December 2020, Nathan departed from his family residence in Whaletown, British Columbia, in a 14-foot skiff rowboat. He was thought to be en route to a location near the Pryce Channel, Deer Passage and or Toba Inlet in British Columbia. Despite having left with supplies that would have lasted him for several months, Nathan had backcountry experience and would have eventually returned. Nathan had medical and some mobility issues.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Greying at temples, may have longer hair and a beard
Jacket: Leather, Black, Black leather jacket with a grey hood (zip up style)
Other: Middle Back, Curvature in the spine causing mobility issues

Case reference: 2018041224.CaseDesc: Ashley Morin was last seen leaving a house in North Battleford, Saskatchewan on July 10, 2018. Ashley left the house on foot, and has not been in contact with family or friends since.

Case reference: 2013000037.CaseDesc: On November 29, 2001, Henry Murillo Asprilla was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, he had a meeting with lawyers, which he attended with his ex-wife. After the meeting he drove his ex-wife home. Henry has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006011199.CaseDesc: On May 9, 1986, Gregory Beaumont left the Silver Lake Campground by boat to fish on the lake. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2020011631.CaseDesc: On January 29, 1975, at approximately 8:30 am, Simon Wilson was seen for the last time as he left his home for school in Toronto, Ontario. Simon did not arrive at school.

Case reference: 2006011399.CaseDesc: Raymond Juranitch went hunting and fishing on the Ogoki Reservoir 80 km northeast of Armstrong, Ontario. He was last seen alone in a 16' aluminum canoe, powered by a 9.8 HP outboard motor. An extensive search of the area failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2021055005.CaseDesc: On July 31, 2016, Karen Thompson was last seen at her daughter’s birthday party at Prince of Whales Park in Toronto, Ontario.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Elephant on left or right shoulder
Lower Back, 3 skulls on lower back

Case reference: 2018046253.CaseDesc: On January 31, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Daphne Powell was seen for the last time as she left her residence in Toronto, Ontario. Daphne left her residence with two suitcases, some money and indicated that she was going to Jamaica.

Case reference: 2017072938.CaseDesc: On March 8, 1988, Nadine Sharp was seen for the last time. She was a student at the University of Toronto and went missing from her home in Etobicoke, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020015970.CaseDesc: On August 31, 2017, John Spratt was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. John is known to be homeless, and has been diagnosed with some serious health issues. John would always check in with his family every couple of years, however, they have not heard from him since 2017.

Case reference: 2005001999.CaseDesc: In September 1979, Norman Ritchie, was a passenger in a 16 foot cedar strip boat on Georgian Bay near Cove Island, when it capsized. Five victims were recovered, but Norman has never been located. He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2009005299.CaseDesc: David Chevrier suffers from a mental health disorder and is cognitively impaired. He was last seen at the Centre of Friends on Main street in North Bay, Ontario.

Case reference: 2018043199.CaseDesc: In December of 1995, Myung Lim was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Myung and his wife had an argument and he told her he was returning to South Korea.

Case reference: 2014005977.CaseDesc: On January 21, 2013, Christopher Thompson was last sighted leaving his parents' residence in Welland, Ontario. Several days later, his vehicle was located abandoned in the area of Netherby Rd and Rusholm Rd. At the time of disappearance, Christopher was feeling despondent and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2011005499.CaseDesc: Lukas was last seen on October 3, 2011, heading into the bushes behind Chomista Trailer park. His duffle bag was located in the bushes with his personal property on October 7, 2011. He was en route to his sister's place, but never arrived. Lukas has ties to Winnipeg and Calgary.

Case reference: 2025049564.CaseDesc: Sean McCready was last seen on September 6, 2025 in Sherwood Park, Alberta. Strathcona RCMP are requesting assistance from the public in locating Sean, in order to verify his wellbeing.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Long curly hair and sports a Goatee
Backpack: Black, Small waterproof roll-backpack designed for cycling
Jacket: "STORMTEK" brand Columbian style jacket with hood
Shoes: Black, Grey, "Skechers " brand; black with grey soles
Scar: Faded scar - unknown if Left or Right Shin

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:
On September 18, 1978, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Toronto Harbour of Lake Ontario. His post-mortem weight was 163lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.
Staining on his teeth suggest that he may have been a smoker. It is estimated that he had been in the water for several weeks.

Teeth: Stained, Overbite & several amalgam fillings. Several teeth lost/extracted during life; lower right lateral incisor being most obvious.

Case reference: 2022065086.CaseDesc: Marcos Sosa Mercado was last seen on November 18, 2022 in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At that time Marcos was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2006011599.CaseDesc: Ervin Bollom was last seen on Obonga Lake, 30 km south of Armstrong, on October 9, 1974.  He had left in his boat to get medical help for an injured friend. His boat was found with the throttle in the "open" position.

Ring: Left Ring Finger, wedding ring - E.B. engraved on the inside
Tattoo: Left Arm, red rose with green stem and the text "true love"

Case reference: 1998000820.CaseDesc: Tom Marsden was last seen at a bush party near Summit Lake north of the City of Prince George.

Case reference: 2014003349.CaseDesc: On March 14, 1993, Carl Berg Ellingsen was seen for the last time with his family at his residence in the East Vancouver region of British Columbia. Carl has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2019040207.CaseDesc: On July 16, 2015, Denis Chernov was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Before he was reported missing, Denis had not been seen or heard from for four years.

Case reference: 2014004934.CaseDesc: On February 28, 1976, at approximately 5:30 pm, Jean Cardinale was seen for the last time at the Bayview Village Plaza in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006020399.CaseDesc: Lawrence Prettie was last seen on October 23, 1994. His boat capsized on Lac Seul and he is presumed drowned. His body has never been recovered.  His boat, camping and fishing gear were located strewn about on an island in Lac Seul.

Case reference: 2021019974.CaseDesc: On May 18, 2021, Jason Lambert was reported missing by his family.  Jason was last seen on or about April 16, 2021, departing from a residence in Oliver, British Columbia.  Jason has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2018040962.CaseDesc: Ryan Duncan was last seen on July 17, 2018, at a motel in Lumby, British Columbia, while travelling in the area. Ryan's vehicle was located in Vernon, British Columbia on July 21, 2018.

Case reference: 2012020116.CaseDesc: On April 1, 1975, Sylvie Ouimet left the Albert-Prevost institution, where she was hospitalized, without any of her personal effects. Her family has not heard from her since.

Scar: Ears, Surgical scar behind the ear

Case reference: 2014003100.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1995, Jacob Sallenback was seen for the last time at his residence in Calgary, AB.

Shirt: Other, TEE, Kings Crew logo, Aqua

Case reference: 2014003746.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1972, Mario Cardinal was reported missing by his family. At the time of his disappearance, he lived in Trois-Rivières, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014003985.CaseDesc: On November 28, 1974 Randall Crighton was seen for the last time in Richmond, British Columbia. He was involved in a motor vehicle accident with a friend who had left the scene. Randall has not been seen or heard from since. Randall had substance abuse problems and may have been despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2020011692.CaseDesc: Joyce MacDougall was last heard from on March 13, 1986, at approximately 7:30pm. Joyce telephoned her mother to inform her that she was going out for a few drinks, but she never returned home. On March 14, Joyce interacted with the police in Niagara Falls and during the course of the interaction she was issued a ticket and was taken to a restaurant. She was last seen at the restaurant by a server and had left her purse in the restaurant.

Mark: Cheek, Mole on the left side of the cheek

Case reference: 2014003860.CaseDesc: Carl Charles Raun was reported missing on July 28 1975. He had sustained a spinal fusion, necessitating the use of a brace. There is a possibility that Carl's disappearance may be the result of foul play, however this has not yet been confirmed.

Case reference: 2022060063.CaseDesc: Dustin Ireson's last contact was on November 13, 2022. His black Dodge Ram truck was found abandoned on November 24, 2022, in a parking lot near the Days Inn in Sarnia, Ontario.  During this period, Dustin was experiencing feelings of despondency.  Surveillance footage captured a man believed to be Dustin parking the truck and walking south toward the waterfront.  Despite extensive search efforts, Dustin's whereabouts remained unknown.

Tattoo: Unknown, Maple leaf with #11 in the middle of the leaf.
Right Abdomen, "IRESON" in vertical block letters on the left side

Case reference: 2020011788.CaseDesc: On May 22, 1982, Ian Shim was seen for the last time when he checked into the Gran Hotel in Pereira, Columbia. Ian, a resident of Toronto, Ontario, was on vacation in Colombia. Shortly after checking in, Ian had gone for a hike, but never returned to his room to collect his personal belongings.

Case reference: 2024022215.CaseDesc: Jacob Penner was last seen on May 6, 2024 in the vicinity of High Level, Alberta. The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is requesting the public's cooperation in providing information regarding the location of Jacob.

Case reference: 2014002404.CaseDesc: On June 11, 1988, Andrew Flett was walking with others to the cutline. He did not arrive at the site, and it was assumed that he had returned to camp. He was reported missing three days later to the RCMP, and an extensive search was conducted. Andrew has not been located, and his whereabouts are currently unknown.

Shirt: Red, Black, Plaid and button up

Case reference: 2012020089.CaseDesc: Michel Guy Favreau lived alone in Nipawin, Saskatchewan at the time of his disappearance. Michel suffered from depression and he was last heard from and seen between September 22nd and September 25th, 2011. On October 4th, 2011 his vehicle, a 1998 green Chrysler Intrepid, was located abandoned at Carroll's Cove camp ground near Nipawin. Several searches were conducted in hopes of locating him were unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2014001540.CaseDesc: Marie Laliberté was a resident of east Vancouver who was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. She was last seen by her resource worker on January 1, 1997. Due to her increasingly sporadic contact with family and a lack of social interaction with others, she was not reported missing until March 8, 2002.

Case reference: 2014006470.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2001, Shahzad Ahmed was seen for the last time at his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Shahzad last contacted his mother by telephone to tell her that he had been fired from his job. During the course of their conversation, his mother had told him to return home to her apartment in Toronto, but he never arrived. The next telephone call that Shahzad’s mother received was from the Islamabad police in Pakistan, who had informed her that Shahzad’s luggage had been found unclaimed on the airport luggage carousel.

Case reference: 2017020043.CaseDesc: Louis Judah Gonick was seen being picked up by taxi cab at his University dormitory residence at 7:09 PM, April 16, 2017, and was last seen at 7:32 PM, being dropped off at the Stanley Park causeway.

Case reference: 2012020645.CaseDesc: Peter Mckay was playing on the ice along the South Saskatchewan River in the Riversdale area of Saskatoon, SK in the late afternoon hours of December 31, 1986. Peter subsequently fell into an open portion of the river and was never found.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Orange, with a yellow stripe on the cuff

Case reference: 2023025594.CaseDesc: On September 17, 2010, Tiamanja Palazzo was last observed in close proximity to the American Falls, in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. Tiamanja was subsequently reported missing by her family a short time later. Tiamanja was despondent at the time of her disappearance.

Foreign Object: Middle Back, Steel rod in back
Tattoo: Right Leg, Mermaid - blue and red

Case reference: 2014005543.CaseDesc: In December 2010, Yellowknife RCMP received a call from a concerned family member reporting that they have not seen or heard from Kelvin Smallgeese since September 2010. At the time of his disappearance, Kelvin was believed to be residing in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories.

Teeth: Dental records indicate 6 teeth missing, 11 treated (occlusal) 15 unknown
Tattoo: Left Hand, A rose and a heart

Case reference: 2014005307.CaseDesc: On August 14, 2006, Kevin Lim, Yee Wah Eva Ho and her boyfriend Jackie Li were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Kevin, Yee Wah Eva and Jackie had been friends with Philip Sit who had been reported missing in 2005. Philip’s remains were found five days prior to Eva, Kevin and Jackie’s disappearance. Philip had been the victim of a homicide.

Hair: Black, Straight, Dyed, Dyed red and styled with spikes

Case reference: 2014004550.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2004, David Creaser was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta.

Tattoo: Shoulders, One side features a tigre, and the other, a dragon

Case reference: 2014003729.CaseDesc: On April 6, 1997, Céline Mercier was seen for the last time at her home in Levis, Quebec. Her vehicle was recovered near the Pierre-Laporte Bridge, which spans the cities of Levis and Quebec. Céline hasn’t been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004727.CaseDesc: Roger Belanger was last seen on May 16, 1984, in Peace River, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2006018399.CaseDesc: David Sawyer and his girlfriend were last seen on May 17, 1977. They went fishing for the day on Pickerel Lake, Ontario. Their capsized canoe was recovered but David has not been located. He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2016034844.CaseDesc: On June 3, 2016, Derwin Beardy was seen for the last time in Winnipeg, Manitoba. During the time of his disappearance, Derwin was leading a transient lifestyle.

Shirt: Cotton, Red, White, Red t-shirt with white lettering across back, white emblem left chest

Case reference: 2014001111.CaseDesc: On February 7th, 1994, the remains of an adult male (25-50 years old), 5'10-6'0 tall, with a thin build, were located by land surveying students in a wooded area near the village of Anmore. The investigation determined the cause of death to be a self-inflicted gunshot wound. A black guitar case was found near the remains. He went missing sometime after May 1992.

Belt: Black, Blue, Fabric belt with a metal Indian Chief Belt buckle inscribed "HARA"
Jacket: Cotton, Blue, Blue with Green Gold piping sleeved Windbreaker Jacket
Pants: Nylon, Blue, Maroon, Sweat pants with zipper on cuffs
Shirt: Cotton, Grey, Black, Long Sleeved Sweatshirt

Case reference: 2016012267.CaseDesc: On February 28, 2016, Lorlene Bone was last seen at a friend’s residence on the Shoal River Indian Reserve in Manitoba. Lorlene is a mother of four and it is out of character for her not to contact her family.

Tattoo: Left Side Of Neck, Three hearts

Case reference: 2014002711.CaseDesc: Sharel Haresym was reported missing on September 6, 1984, and was last seen on September 4, 1984. His vehicle was located parked on the entrance road to the Twin Lakes campground near Winfield, Alberta. The vehicle was out of fuel and also had a dead battery. Sharel's clothing was found approximately 90 metres east of his vehicle. His garments were meticulously arranged, with his Bible positioned nearby.

Case reference: 2014005882.CaseDesc: Romeo Cloutier was last seen September 13, 2012 in Moncton, New Brunswick. Romeo's vehicle was located in Sainte-Marie-de-Kent later on that same day. No other confirmed reports of Romeo's whereabouts have been made since.

Tattoo: Neck, Inscription "Keep your friends close, keep enemies closer"

Case reference: 2016061231.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1968, an unidentified male was found hanging in a hotel room. He had checked in under the name Henry Drendorf. No identification was found. This individual was found with several bags of architectural books.

Case reference: 2020006266.CaseDesc: On February 25, 1959, Richard "Ricky" Culford was seen for the last time on Ward’s Island in Toronto, Ontario. He was last seen playing on the beach with a stick. When his mother went to retrieve him, Ricky was gone.

Hat: Brown, Gabardine helmet with a peak

Case reference: 1996000260.CaseDesc: On March 17, 1995, Jay Boyle, Michael Cummings, Daniel Higgins, Jamie Lefebvre, Robert Rumbolt, and Chad Smith were seen for the last time walking towards the East Shore Marina in Pickering, Ontario. It is believed that the six young men boarded a boat that subsequently capsized.

Shoes: Red, Sneakers, Sneakers made of suede
Scar: Ears, Piercing scar on left ear

Hat: Black, Baseball hat-" Detroit Red Wings"

Shoes: Canvas, Black, White, Running shoes, brand "Adidas"

Case reference: 2019040401.CaseDesc: On August 19, 1975, this approximately 60 year old man collapsed on East Hastings Street in Burnaby, British-Columbia. He had a bruise on the left side of his head and had recently undergone cranial surgery due to a head injury.

Case reference: 2014002748.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1981, Jerry Torarak was last seen at 11:15 p.m. near Hopedale, Newfoundland & Labardor. Jerry had been travelling back to Hopedale from Railroads, Newfoundland & Labrador via boat with his family. Approximately 23 kilometers off shore from Hopedale, Jerry fell over board into the water and sank out of sight.

Case reference: 2014005278.CaseDesc: On July 14, 2009, Yashpal Mehay left his residence in Surrey BC, and was scheduled to travel to Clinton BC, where he co-owned and operated a Petro Canada Gas Station with family. Yashpal was last seen at the Costco in Abbotsford BC, at 1450 hours on July 14, 2009, where he purchased tobacco, food and gas. Yashpal failed to arrive at his destination in Clinton BC, and there has been no communication with the family. He was very familiar with this route as he travelled it every other week. The Surrey RCMP has conducted extensive searches along the travelled route with negative results.

Shirt: Green, White, Long sleeve "American Eagle" polo

Case reference: 2014001664.CaseDesc: On September 12, 1982, Harold Larcher and his girlfriend set out on Lake Winnipegosis in separate canoes with their supplies from the Overflowing River in Manitoba. After the river, they were in view of big waves on the lake. Their canoes began to fill with water from the same waves.  His girlfriend's canoe overturned, but she could see that Harold was still in his canoe as she struggled to right her own. She was unable to do so, but at one point she was able to sit on it and eventually made her way to shore, but never saw Harold again. Numerous personal items were recovered, including Harold's passport and a lifejacket that may have belonged to him.  It is presumed that he drowned.
